Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the proposal. We are excited to see Redwood in action, but procurement and security have put a hard stop on live demos until a few intake gates are cleared on our side: a completed vendor questionnaire, signed NDA on file, and vendor portal onboarding (so we can provision an IDP test account). Our internal security team also wants a 1-page summary of hosting/data handling and retention prior to a walkthrough.

Can we pause the live session scheduled for next Wednesday while we get those items in? If preferred, we can accept an asynchronous recording of the demo in the meantime. Otherwise, can you share the vendor packet + a copy of your standard NDA and the short hosting summary?

Apologies — procurement is strict this quarter. CC'ing procurement and Sara from security so they have context.

Thanks Kimberly — procurement here. A few clarifications so we can move forward:

1) Please complete the attached Aventra_Vendor_Portal_Form.xlsx and return by EOD Thu 9/2 so we can create your vendor portal record. The portal step is mandatory before we can approve system access for demos that include any live connection or privileged flows.

2) We’ve received your NDA draft. Our legal team will issue a redline if needed — in the past we accept vendor NDA via DocuSign for initial previews, but a countersigned copy must be on file before production access.

3) Regarding the hosting summary: the 1-pager you attached is OK for an initial review; security may request specifics on key management and retention in follow-up.

If you can return the completed portal form and a signed NDA link by Thursday, procurement can aim to clear for a live demo the following week. If not, please advise if you want to proceed with the recorded alternative.
